title: This no-fee Amex checking account is offering a $300 bonus for a limited time — how to qualify
raw_text:
If you've been looking for a reason to switch checking accounts, American Express is sweetening the deal.
For a limited time only, new Amex Rewards Checking customers can score a pretty good welcome bonus: Earn $300 after opening an account by July 30, 2026, and receiving a total of $7,500 or more in qualifying direct deposits within the first 90 days. You can't have previously held an Amex Rewards Checking account, and the $300 will be deposited within up to eight to 12 weeks of satisfying the requirements.
Here's more on the Amex Rewards Checking.
Monthly maintenance fee
$0
Minimum deposit to open
$0
Minimum balance
Min balance to open = $0
Annual Percentage Yield (APY)
1.00% as of 06/24/2024
Free ATM network
37,000+ MoneyPass® ATMs

None
Overdraft fee
N/A
Mobile check deposit
Yes
Terms apply.
Beyond its welcome offer, the Amex Rewards Checking is also a no-fee account. There's no fee to open an account, no monthly fees and no minimum balance requirements.
Checking account holders earn 1.00% APY, which is actually a pretty good return for a checking account; the national average is just 0.07% APY, for comparison.
The Amex Rewards Checking account is available only to consumers who have had an Amex credit card, savings account or CD for at least five days.
Offers in this section are from affiliate partners and selected based on a combination of engagement, product relevance, compensation, and consistent availability.
With this checking account, you'll earn 1 Membership Rewards® point for every $2 of eligible purchases on your debit car, with no cap on how many points you can earn. Usually, checking accounts don't come with spending rewards like that. If you have an Amex credit card that earns Membership Rewards, you can link to your debit card so that all points earned on both accumulate together.
The Amex Rewards Checking debit card offers zero liability fraud protection for unauthorized charges, as well as purchase protection. Purchase protection is seen as more of a credit card feature where purchases made with your card are protected from accidental damage or theft up to a certain amount of days.
You can make unlimited, fee-free ATM withdrawals with your Amex Rewards debit card at over 70,000 Allpoint® and MoneyPass® ATM locations nationwide.
If you already have the Amex Rewards Checking, here are some other bonuses worth checking out (no pun intended):
The SoFi Checking and Savings* account offers $50 if you receive between $1,000 and $4,999 in direct deposits within the bonus period, or $400 if you receive $5,000 or more. Meanwhile, the Capital One 360 Checking account is offering a $250 cash bonus when you open a new account and receive two direct deposits of $500 or more each within 75 days of opening.
Offers in this section are from affiliate partners and selected based on a combination of engagement, product relevance, compensation, and consistent availability.
And, for a limited time, new Chase Total Checking® account holders can get a $400 bonus when making at least $1,000 in direct deposits within the first 90 days.
- No minimum deposit to open an account
- Overdraft assistance
- Top-rated mobile app
- Chase is no. 2 on J.D. Power's 2019 U.S. National Banking Satisfaction Study
- Send and receive money with Zelle®
- No APY
- No reimbursement for out-of-network ATM fees
How to avoid the monthly fee:
- Electronic deposits made into this account totaling $500 or more,
- or a balance at the beginning of each day of $1,500 or more in this account
- or an average beginning day balance of $5,000 or more in any combination of this account and linked qualifying Chase checking, savings and other balances
